title: Storefront loading fixes: production build and regressions verified
summary: Verified immediate product visibility, no hidden menu image downloads, deferred search/ranking, bounded refresh and the previously optimized responsive hero.

changes.detail: Remove six permanently hidden menu images totaling 12191600 source bytes and unused hidden promotional markup. Retain visible menu links.
Search code loads when opened with a visible loading state; optional recommendation request starts near the catalogue and times out after 5 seconds.
Product rails and collection cards are visible immediately without JavaScript reveal timers or entrance delays.
Settings and client refresh reads have 10-second deadlines so stalled requests do not permanently lock refresh. Boutique no longer refreshes its server shell alongside its client catalogue poll.

validation.name: Focused regressions
validation.detail: 15 storefront/loading/catalogue/cache tests and 6 change-history tests passed (21 total). Includes hidden-menu absence, closed-search exclusion, SSR rail visibility, optional viewport work cancellation and client-only boutique refresh policy.

validation.name: TypeScript and lint
validation.detail: Root tsc --noEmit --incremental false and focused Next lint passed without diagnostics. Full production lint retains existing repository warnings.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Network-enabled node scripts/next-build.mjs exited 0; all 249 static pages generated. Build log: lecomax-learning-app/artifacts/storefront-reliability-build.log.

validation.name: Generated homepage
validation.detail: 593354 bytes of HTML; one hero picture containing one img and both WebP variants; zero hidden menu images; catalogue present. Earlier local HTML was 600306 bytes and live baseline 603935 bytes. Differences are not browser timing measurements.

validation.name: Live baseline
validation.detail: Public HTTP 200, 54011 compressed bytes, 3.011217 s TTFB and 3.607982 s total in one environment-specific request. Live HTML still uses the earlier hero implementation.

validation.name: Deployment and browser measurements
validation.detail: No deployment performed. No post-change live LCP/INP/CLS, mobile browser or checkout end-to-end verification. Browser inventory was unavailable in this session. These checks do not guarantee every request under every network condition.
